_comment: THE single source for every origin, CSP value and CORS value in this project.
CLAUDE.md section 2: 'keep every origin/CSP/CORS value in one config module so it is a
one-file change later.' This is that file. `_headers` and assets/js/config.js are both
GENERATED from it by scripts/build-site-config.mjs, and CI regenerates them and fails on
any diff -- so 'one-file change' is enforced rather than promised.
To point the project at a real domain: edit `domains` here, run the generator, commit.
Nothing else in the repository should ever contain a hostname.
_planned_comment: Origins that CLAUDE.md commits to but that nothing loads yet. Deliberately NOT emitted:
a CSP that allows an origin the site does not use is weaker than it needs to be today,
and 'we will need it eventually' is how an allowlist grows. Move an entry into `csp`
in the milestone that actually introduces it -- one line, in this file.

turnstile.milestone: M1 — Turnstile on signup and submit (section 6)

_csp_comment: No 'unsafe-inline' and no 'unsafe-eval' anywhere -- section 6. @tokens resolve to
default-src 'none' means every directive not listed below is DENIED, so adding a new
kind of subresource is a deliberate edit here rather than something that silently works.
form-action 'none': nothing in this app submits an HTML form. Supabase Auth is fetch().
Set to 'none' rather than 'self' because the attack it stops is an injected <form> that
POSTs a password somewhere else, and 'self' does not stop that being staged.
_headers_comment: Referrer-Policy is no-referrer, not the usual strict-origin-when-cross-origin. This is a
politically sensitive archive (section 7); an outbound link should not tell the
destination which page of it the reader came from.
Permissions-Policy: microphone is allowed for 'self' because voice notes are a first-class
content type and M1 may record in-browser. Camera and geolocation are denied outright --
nothing in CLAUDE.md asks for either, and device geolocation on a heritage map is a

headers.Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), payment=(), usb=(), microphone=(self)

_known_violations_comment: External origins the prototype front end still loads, every one of which this CSP BLOCKS
and CLAUDE.md already forbids. Listed here so CI can ratchet: a new external origin fails
the build, and removing one requires deleting its line, which is the point.
None of these break anything today -- `_headers` is a Cloudflare Pages file and the site
is not on Cloudflare Pages yet. They break the moment it is. That is deliberate: it makes
M4 and M6 unable to ship without doing what CLAUDE.md already requires.

known_violations.why: Leaflet JS + CSS from a third-party CDN
section 2: NEVER the public OSM tile endpoint
section 9 wants a self-hosted subset; also leaks reader IPs to a third party
